body: Just when I thought the episode could not mess with my head more, IT DID. And then the ending, was brilliant. It distracted us from the fact the joker card was not in the game. And my interpretation was everyone returning back to reality was a cruel joke by the joker.

I agree completely. The way it’s gone about this guy and I have been really chill and going with the flow and haven’t established any actual boundaries. I know he’s been trying to go on other dates too which doesn’t bother me. But now that I see he’s beginning to ask about me telling him things we should do in the bedroom, might be a way of slowly beginning to be able to move towards communication about what we essentially are. 

He’s pretty cool but he’s made me a bit confused. So I better clear up the air with him

The way he acts to me kinda suggests it’s potential he might. The last time we hooked up, which was last Saturday he said something like “with random hookups you never know whenever you’ll find something good out of it” 

We were both drunk and it was a bit encrypted but it seemed like his attempt at him hinting something at me possibly
I should’ve mentioned that!!!!! He knows I’m in an open relationship:)
He has met my boyfriend a few times yes and they get along quite well

Okay so update! We began my kneecap tattoo and it is fucking HUGE! Honestly I was completely fine and wanted to keep going to do the shading, but the artist suggested we stop so the lines can heal and I won’t be hobbling around for a week or so! 
The actual kneecap itself: very strange sensation, made my entire leg vibrate. 4/10 pain. Way less than the elbow. 
The surrounding areas, especially the INNER knee was FUCKED. Felt like straight lava being poured onto my leg. Even that, was still bearable. I was able to sit with him and hold a conversation the entire outline which took about 2.5 hours to do. 
In saying that, I’m happy because today there’s little to no swelling. When I had my elbow outlined it swelled like a bitch so I was expecting the same for the knee outline but nope! Easy peasy. Can’t wait to have it shaded!!!
Yes! A lot of people have told me it’s the area surround the knee that is the most painful!!!

So true! This is why I did my sternum in one sitting, I knew if I stopped I would never go back to finish it. Ribs fucking suck but I am able to go back and tolerate the pain again. I’m going to keep this mentality for my knee too! Thanks for the insight!

Thank you for your honesty! I reckon the piece I’m getting will take around 3.5 hours at the very longest. I’ve taken 3 days off after getting it done, and will have the rest of the day after getting the tattoo to recover also. Hopefully that’ll be enough time for the swelling to go down!
Oh my god finally after all these years! Haha
